strings.en: 1. Destroy all enemies
1. All allies destroyed
A strange gravity zone...? What is this...!?
What's this? Meteors arranged in a ring...?
I thought this point was just an ordinary asteroid belt.
Exactly. What on earth is going on here?
I can't make heads or tails of it...
It kind of looks like Stonehenge in England.
What's that?
A ring of stones. Nobody really knows who built most of them, or why.
But why would one be out in space, where there's no ground?
You can see them in Japan too, in places like Hokkaido.
Hokkaido? What, crabs?
Koji, just be quiet.
Why would something that occult be out in space?
Surely a coincidence? The ground and space are worlds apart.
I don't think you can lump them together.
Tetsuya, you really got no sense of wonder, I tell ya.
There doesn't seem to be anything in particular here.
Captain, shouldn't we avoid wasted trips?
Or we might not make it in time when it counts, like last time...
I know, Lieutenant. But we know far too little about the enemy...
Not just their strength, but even their goal.
So no effort is too much for that. But this time, it seems a miss...
...Wait!
Maria...?
...Wh-what... is this... Ugh...
What's with you all of a sudden?
Maria, you got a stomachache? And Excellen too...
B-Brother... Take Grendizer...
Grendizer? What are you saying...
Everyone, we have to launch or we're in trouble!
Are you all right, Maria?
...Lieutenant Uraki, Maria can see the future. Right, big brother?
Yeah. It worries me... Captain, I'll head out for now.
If there's nothing out there, all the better.
I'm going out too. ...Something about this... just bugs me...
(What is it... this sense of dread... There's... something here...?)
...Understood. All hands, launch. Stay on your guard.
What!? The enemy!?
Never seen that type. A new model? Or... yet another new enemy!?
Feels like every time we go somewhere, we run into a new enemy.
Seriously.
Now, now. If it comes to this, we'll just take them all out one by...
...!! What?
Hm? What's wrong?
Just now... Didn't you hear a voice?
A voice? What are you talking about?
This... pla...ce...
I knew it! Captain! It's saying something!?
Who is?
Huh?
They're attacking!?
No contact on comms... Can't be helped. Intercept them!
There's a good chance they're new enemy units!
...Ugh... That's... not it...
Maria? Maria!
Daisuke! Let's deal with the enemy in front of us first!
We'll worry about Maria after that!
But what in the world...
Maria! What on earth is wrong!?
Daisuke! Maria was acting strange before they even showed up.
Either way, doesn't that make them dangerous!?
So that's all we can do...! All right, Tetsuya.
Any enemy in our way has to be defeated regardless!
(Hey... what's going on? I'm the only one... who can hear it...?)
Ngh...! This... this feeling...!?
High energy reading at the center of the circle!? What!?
Tch, more of them...!
...Hmm, maybe it was just my imagination? I don't hear anything...
Captain, did the enemy respond to our hails?
...No, we couldn't connect. In fact, I doubt they even received us.
What do you mean?
They may be some kind of... life form. No heat source, no metal...
Then again, there were no life signs either...
Space creatures...?
Come on, this isn't science fiction...
Yeah, yeah. Isn't the equipment just busted?
All of it at once? That's weird.
Maria, have you calmed down?
Yeah... But, Brother...
What was that about? Maybe I'm... a psychic too?
A psychic...?
These guys just don't quit!
Where did they come from!? I didn't see them!
There's somethin' real creepy about these guys, I tell ya.
Where did they come from!? There was nothing at the center!
I have no idea. What on earth...
There's somethin' real creepy about these guys, I tell ya.
Reinforcements...!?
...!! What is that...!?
Who... are you...?
Who? Who are YOU!?
Excellen, what's wrong? You've been acting strangely for a while now.
N-nothing...
Here they come! Intercept them!
You're going to answer me! Who are you?
The appointed time... draws near...
Could you say that so I can understand? From your voice...
Are you a cute little girl, maybe?
...Little... girl? I am not... I am... you.
If you... were more complete... I too... would be more...
Okay, stooop! Could you explain it in order!? So I get it!
(Somehow... it doesn't feel like we've just met... Who is this girl...?)
Damn, looks like it's still got plenty left. Tough bastard.
Still holding on? ...This one's a cut above the ones before.
Tell me who you are... and maybe I'll let you go.
What's with you all of a sudden?
Do you know that robot?
Excellen, do you know that mysterious enemy?
Huh? No, no, I just thought maybe we could get acquainted.
(Something's definitely off... And nobody else seems to hear her voice.)
...Kyo...suke...
I am going... to see him... What I lack... so that I can be... me...
Wait...!
Hold it, Excellen. ...We can't catch up at that speed.
What was that? It just showed up... And Excellen's acting odd too...
What are you doing!? Keep scanning! Wipe out the rest and leave this area!
What a pain. Let's just wipe 'em all out!
They're the enemy either way, right?
But this place... scares me. I think we should get out of here fast...
Battle Mastery increased by 1.
No enemies... And the energy readings are gone too...
What is this area...?
Brother, I have a really... really bad feeling. Let's leave quickly.
Maria, this isn't like you. You're awfully timid.
Yeah. Now that we're here, why don't we flip over every rock?
They might be stuck all over the undersides, right?
They're not pond snails, you know...
Maybe we should just go over every inch. We might learn something.
No, we should withdraw. ...Something here feels off. Besides...
She may just be tired, but she's acting strange too...
Hey, what's wrong?
Huh? Oh, please, it's nothing. No need to fuss, Lieutenant!
Captain, if we're searching, let's search for enemies.
No, we're leaving. We still have a mountain of work to do.
We can't spend time on something this uncertain.
...All units, return to the ship.
Can't be helped, I suppose...
I'd like to look into it... That red one especially felt different...
(Kyosuke... She definitely said Kyosuke. What is going on?
Kyosuke, would you understand this...?)
